files.disposition: S13 original control entry, task/borrow lifetime and native call restoration; coordinate S14 state/FNID provenance.
evidence: F edit_entry validates current WOW task and registered class atoms, retains existing window binding, enters task/borrow scopes, captures display geometry, calls original ComboBoxWndProc, then restores TLS and releases references/scopes in finally.

C remains owner of combo message/state behavior. Native paint/focus/capture/message/window operations use shared task-aware provider; private CBOX/PWND state cannot become a modern native pointer by cast. Do not move original combo algorithm wholesale to F or put mixed layout/runtime precomp into B.

files.disposition: S13 current-runtime HWND-to-retained-state validation; original directory/list algorithms stay C.
evidence: Only observed direct external symbol is wow_window_client_validate_window. It obtains current runtime, enters it if necessary, borrows exact retained window state, then restores runtime and last error. This is not interchangeable with public IsWindow.
Original routines use _GetDlgItem, CBOX/LBIV fields and original directory helper/lock order. Existing approved _GetDlgItem B/C exception is unchanged; this audit does not expand it.

files.disposition: S13 native creation/task/class binding; S14 original extracted state/FNID review.
evidence: C chooses list/edit child classes from atomSysClass, geometry/styles, ANSI creator flag and ordered cleanup, including list destruction before parent becomes zombie. Preserve that creation/destruction policy and original state allocation/free.

F entry copies already registered class atoms before invoking C; _CreateWindowEx maps to wow_control_create_window_ex, which validates admitted call shape, reads current class provider/version and forwards explicit version/encoding to common create_bound path before native callbacks.
Original SetWindowState/ClearWindowState and selected NtUserSetWindowFNID were previously extracted to F; their origin is a separate S14 decision, not proof all adapter code belongs permanently in F.

limits: No source/ABI changes. Actual state ownership and current call chains are recorded, not a necessity/minimality approval for every adapter or authorization to remove original algorithms. Existing C0064 and symbol IDs remain open; S13/S14 are not implemented.
